title: Keep Climbing, SlapJam 2026 Contender
author: Jack_Maxwell_PI
selftext:
Hey everybody, 

This was a game that we made in about 36ish hours for SlapJam's 2026 AI game jam, and pretty much all of the art and game design was done with ChatGPT-6 Astra, with some polish and code cleanup by Claude Fable 5, sound via Suno, and a small amount of concepting done with Gemini.

It turned out way better than I ever could have hoped for such a short amount of time. It took a full two weeks of usage (thank AI God for banked resets), but it was absolutely worth it in the end! Being able to make things like this is why I genuinely think there's a huge place for AI in the world of game design and art in general; I had Astra plug into Aesprite to draw all of the characters, backgrounds, and animations seen in the game. 

If you play it, I hope you enjoy!
